name: egm-brainstorm
title: Brainstorm
purpose: Turn a half-formed idea into a clear problem and a few testable options before anyone writes a design.
use_when: You have an idea, a request or a pain point, but not yet a shared understanding of it.
you_get: concepts_brief.md: the problem, goals, options and open questions, already challenged by fresh reviewers.
example: /egm-pilot:egm-brainstorm Let admins export invoices as CSV

name: egm-draft
title: Draft
purpose: Write the design document one section at a time, with your approval at each section.
use_when: The problem and the approach are agreed, from a brief or your own notes.
you_get: design_draft.md, following the feature-spec standard and ready for review.

name: egm-review
title: Review
purpose: Have fresh reviewers with no memory of the conversation pull the design apart, in five stages.
use_when: A design draft exists and you want it proven implementable before code is written.
you_get: consolidated_review_report.md: ranked findings with evidence, from zoom-out to implementation readiness.

name: egm-resolve
title: Resolve
purpose: Go through review findings with you, one decision at a time: apply the fix, contest it, or defer it.
use_when: A review has produced findings and you want them settled, not just listed.
you_get: An updated document and a record of every decision and why.

name: egm-review-loop
title: Review loop
purpose: Run a chosen set of reviewers against any document and apply the fixes you approve, round after round.
use_when: You need a focused check of a README, plan or spec against a standard or template.
you_get: The reviewed document with approved fixes applied, plus a findings report.

name: egm-drift-report
title: Drift report
purpose: Compare checked-in design docs and READMEs with the code as it is today.
use_when: The code has moved on since the docs were written, or a build against a spec has finished.
you_get: An actionable list of where the documents and the code disagree.

name: egm-bootstrap
title: Bootstrap
purpose: Create or update a README for each directory in a code subtree, written from the code itself.
use_when: You are adopting EGM in a repo with little documentation for agents or people to start from.
you_get: Directory README.md files that describe what each part of the code does.

name: egm-init
title: Init
purpose: Register your repos once, so Autopilot knows how each one builds, tests and connects before a run starts.
use_when: Before your first Autopilot run, or after a repo has changed a lot. Optional.
you_get: ~/.egm: a repo registry, per-repo knowledge and a cross-repo contract map.

name: egm-autopilot
title: Autopilot
purpose: Take a task or an idea all the way to a reviewed Draft MR: spec, review, tests-first build, code review.
use_when: You want a change built and reviewed against your repo's standards, unattended or with you at every step.
you_get: Draft MRs in your name, with the spec, the review record and the open decisions in the description.
